question: Although the accepted date for the founding of the Order is March 18, 1919, DeMolay was actually founded on __________.
adminNote: Handbook agrees: launched March 24, 1919 (first club meeting Feb 19, 1919).

question: Who was the first DeMolay to take the obligation?
The Founder of the Order of DeMolay was born on __________.
adminNote: Handbook: Frank Sherman Land born June 21, 1890.

question: At what age was Louis Lower introduced to the Founder of DeMolay?
adminNote: Handbook 'The First DeMolay' section says seventeen; another section says sixteen. 16 is not an option.

question: Who wrote the ageless Ritual of the Order of DeMolay?
adminNote: Frank A. Marshall.

question: Jacques DeMolay, the person for whom the Order was named, was the last known __________ of the Knights Templars.
The Knights Templars were given sanction by the Pope of the Roman Catholic Church in the year __________.
adminNote: Handbook: sanctioned by the Church in 1128. Exam file had '11 17' (typo for 1117).

question: He was instrumental in the institution of the first DeMolay Chapter in the Philippines.
adminNote: Philippine DeMolay history: Dad Michael Goldenberg was Acting Deputy for the Philippines in 1946.

question: The Chapter was instituted on __________.
adminNote: A. Mabini Petitioner's Handbook: instituted April 22, 1984. (Charter granted Oct 7, 1984 is the distractor.)

question: Bro. __________ was installed as the first Master Councilor of the A. Mabini Chapter.
adminNote: Roll of Past Master Councilors: 1984-A Ramon S. Herrera.

question: Where was the first DeMolay Chapter instituted?
adminNote: The Mother Chapter, Kansas City, Missouri, was the first chapter.

question: Frank S. Land became a Mason at the age of 22 when he joined __________.
adminNote: Ivanhoe Lodge No. 446 (petition April 1912, raised July 23, 1912).

question: Frank A. Marshall worked as a journalist of __________.
adminNote: Kansas City Journal (drama and music critic).

question: Jacques DeMolay was born in __________ in the Department of Haute Saone, France.
adminNote: Handbook: born in Vitrey, Haute Saone, France, 1244.

question: The Knights Templars were answerable only to whom?

options.text: the prince or king in which their Preceptories are located

question: The first Chapter in the Philippines was instituted in __________.
adminNote: Jose Abad Santos Chapter No. 1, March 1946.

question: Where was the first Installation of Officers of the Chapter held?
adminNote: Handbook: SSS Empress Hall, Tropical Palace Resort Hotel, April 22, 1984.

question: Who was elected the first President of DeMolay?
adminNote: Gorman A. McBride, first Master Councilor of the Mother Chapter.

question: Dad Frank S. Land was known as the __________ in his hometown.
adminNote: 'The Boy Preacher'.

question: At what age did Louis Lower die?
adminNote: 'He was forty-one years of age.'

question: Frank A. Marshall died on __________.
adminNote: 'He Died on March 24, 1931 at the age of 65.'

question: In __________, DeMolay was elected to the highest position in the hierarchy of the Knights Templars.
adminNote: Handbook: named Grand Master in 1298.

question: Who was named by Frank S. Land as the first Executive Officer for the Philippines, Guam and Okinawa?
adminNote: Grand Lodge of the Philippines bio: MW Manuel M. Crudo was 'for years the Executive Officer of the Council for the Philippines, Guam and Okinawa'. 'First' and 'named by Land' not explicitly confirmed.

question: The BF Parañaque Masonic Club was formed in __________.
adminNote: 'Sometime December 1979, a group of masons...'

question: The Chapter elected its first set of Officers on __________.
adminNote: 'April 1, 1984 - Election of first set of Officers.'

question: Who was the first Grand Master of the International Supreme Council?
adminNote: DeMolay International past Grand Masters: #1 Alexander G. Cochran, 1921-1928.

question: Before it changed its name on March 1, 1954, the International Supreme Council was known as the __________.

options.text: Grand Chapter of the Order of DeMolay
Grand Consistory of the Order of DeMolay
Grand Council of the Order of DeMolay

adminNote: DeMolay training materials: in March 1954 the name Grand Council was changed to International Supreme Council.

question: Of all the titles, honors, awards and distinctions given to him, which did Frank S. Land consider the most important?
Louis Lower was shot in the chest by a(n) __________ .
adminNote: Handbook: a drunken security guard.

question: How long did Jacques DeMolay endure the rack and the dungeon?
adminNote: Handbook: 'For seven years...'

question: Who issued the secret writs for the arrest of the Knights Templars?
adminNote: King Philip IV (the Fair) of France.

question: The first group that comprised the Chapter’s Charter Members was given the Degrees on __________ by members of the Gen. Douglas MacArthur Chapter of Manila.
adminNote: 'March 18, 1984 - 7 young boys were conferred Initiatory Degree by the Gen. Douglas McArthur Chapter.'

question: The first non-American DeMolay Chapter was instituted in which of the following countries?
adminNote: Winnipeg Chapter, Canada, February 24, 1923 (DeMolay Canada history).

question: The second Grand Master of the International Supreme Council was __________.
adminNote: DeMolay International past Grand Masters: #2 John H. Glazier, 1928-1931.

question: Frank S. Land died on __________.
adminNote: Frank S. Land died November 8, 1959.

question: At the time of his death, Louis Lower was the Director of the __________ of Kansas City, Missouri.
adminNote: Director of the Municipal Auditorium, Kansas City.

question: Frank A. Marshall was the editor of __________ from March 1921 up to his death.
adminNote: The Cordon is DeMolay's official magazine. Marshall as its editor was not independently confirmed; the other options are not DeMolay publications.

question: Jacques DeMolay was burned at the stake on an island in the __________ .
adminNote: Standard history: burned on the Ile aux Juifs in the Seine, Paris, March 18, 1314.

question: The founder and first Grand Master of the Knights Templars was__________.
adminNote: Hugues de Payens (Hugh de Payen), founder and first Grand Master of the Templars.

question: What was the first Philippine DeMolay Chapter?
adminNote: Jose Abad Santos Chapter (1946) was the first chapter in the Philippines and the Far East.

question: Who was the fourth Master Councilor of the Chapter?
adminNote: Roll of Past Master Councilors: 1985-B Allan Benjamin V. Maneze is fourth.

question: Who presides over the Philippine DeMolay Congress?
adminNote: The National Master Councilor heads the National DeMolay Congress (handbook lists NMC, NSC, NJC, Treasurer, Congress Secretary).

question: The __________ is the only official position in the Chapter that may be filled by an Active DeMolay, a Senior DeMolay, or a Master Mason.
adminNote: Handbook: the Scribe 'can be an active or senior DeMolay' and is appointed by the Advisory Council. 'Or a Master Mason' not confirmed in the handbook.

question: Which of the following appendant groups of the Order is composed of DeMolays and Master Masons who have been elevated to the rank, dignity and honor of a Legionnaire of the Order?
adminNote: Legion of Honor members are organised in Preceptories led by a Dean.

question: The __________ symbolizes the purity of a member’s intentions to always remember the motto of the Order.
adminNote: 'The Five-armed WHITE CROSS symbolizes the purity of your intentions to always remember the motto of the Order.' The exam file lettered these options a, b, d, e; they were relabelled a-d.

question: According to its Founder, DeMolay is like a religion because __________.

options.text: it is hard to define and must be experienced by the members for it to be fully understood
it offers a means of salvation for each of its members through its rituals
it has a hierarchy of sorts that is similar in nature and function to that of a church
it is both mystical and supernatural, and demands the complete surrender of its members

adminNote: Options b-d contradict DeMolay teaching (it is not a religion and offers no salvation). Land's comparison, that it is hard to define and must be experienced, was not found verbatim.

question: In which series below are the cardinal virtues of the Order arranged in their proper sequence?

options.text: reverence for sacred things, filial love, comradeship

adminNote: Order of the virtues: Filial Love, Reverence for Sacred Things, Courtesy, Comradeship, Fidelity, Cleanness, Patriotism.

question: “A DeMolay is courteous.” This courtesy is intended for __________.
adminNote: Ceremony of Light: courtesy 'transcends friendships, reaches to the stranger, to the aged, to all men.' Option c (strangers) is partly true; d is the widest.

question: The __________ is the representative of the Supreme Council in the region to which he is assigned.
adminNote: The Executive Officer is the adult leader who represents the Supreme Council in a jurisdiction (handbook: 'Executive Officer of the Jurisdiction').

question: The __________ governs the workings of the Supreme Council of the Order of DeMolay, Republic of the Philippines.
adminNote: The Philippine Provisional Supreme Council adopted its Statutes (1983). Not found verbatim.

question: How many Jurisdictional Master Councilors are there at a given time?
adminNote: Jurisdictional Master Councilors for Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao.

question: One of his clearly defined tasks is to ensure that new members are properly coached and trained as they enter the Order.
adminNote: Handbook: the Junior Councilor handles recruitment, orientation and coaching of new initiates.

question: The full name of the Order of Knighthood is __________.

options.text: The Chivalric Order of the Knights of Jacques DeMolay
The Chivalric Order of the Fellow Soldiers of Jacques DeMolay
The Holy Order of the Fellow Knights of Jacques DeMolay
The Chivalric Knights of the Holy Order of the Fellow Soldiers of Jacques DeMolay

adminNote: 'The Chivalric Knights of the Holy Order of the Fellow Soldiers of Jacques DeMolay.'

question: They denote justice, fortitude and mercy in the official DeMolay emblem.
adminNote: Handbook: crossed swords denote justice, fortitude and mercy.

question: The Order of DeMolay aims to __________ the home, church and school.
adminNote: '...but rather to supplement them...'

question: This virtue teaches a DeMolay that true heroism may be practiced in peace as well as in war.
adminNote: Ethic: 'A DeMolay is patriot in peace as well as at war.'

question: “A DeMolay, by __________ and __________, must preserve the high standards to which he has pledged himself.”
adminNote: 'A DeMolay by precept and example must preserve the high standards...'

question: Who is charged with the supervision of the day-to-day operations of the Supreme Council offices?
adminNote: DeMolay International: the Grand Secretary controls the general offices. Philippine Statutes not checked.

question: Which is not a function of the Supreme Council?

options.text: as a central office of record

adminNote: SCOD serves as a central office of record, an agency for service, an agency for PROMOTION and a source of unification.

question: He ensures that the Chapter has an aggressive and effective mechanism for the recruitment, training and coaching of new members.
adminNote: The Membership Advisor's role, by name and function.

question: He guards the outer door of the Chapter and prevents the entrance of non-members into the Chapter room when the Chapter is in session.
adminNote: The Sentinel guards the outer door of the Chapter room.

question: The equivalent of the Master Councilor in the Order of Knighthood is known as the __________.
adminNote: A Knighthood unit is a Priory led by an Illustrious Knight Commander (handbook: 'Past Illustrious Knight Commander').

question: What do the ten precious jewels in the DeMolay emblem signify?

options.text: the seven cardinal virtues and the three Councilors of the Chapter
the ten plagues unleashed by Moses on the Egyptians
the Founder and the nine original members of the Order
the nine founding knights of the Templars and Jacques DeMolay

adminNote: 'The ten precious stones honor our founder, Frank S. Land and the nine youths...'

question: DeMolay accomplishes its goal of building better citizens by offering the teenage young man of today all of the following, except __________.

options.text: a wholesome occupation for their spare time

adminNote: The four offerings are: wholesome spare-time occupation, worthwhile associates, best of environment, a complete youth program.

question: The sages named this love agape, or love for no other reason than the sake of being.
adminNote: Official Ceremony of Light, first candle: 'the love between parent and child... The sages named this love agape.' That candle is filial love.

question: “A DeMolay’s __________ is as good as his bond.”
adminNote: 'A DeMolay's word is as good as his bond.'

question: These are issuances by the Grand Master of the Supreme Council and have the power of law.
adminNote: Edicts of the Grand Master carry the force of law in Masonic-style statutes. Philippine Statutes not found.

question: This position in the Chapter is second only in importance to that of the Chapter Advisor.
adminNote: Scribe: 'second only in importance to the post of the chapter advisor.'

question: In the emblem of the Order of Knighthood, which part denotes steadfastness?
adminNote: Knighthood emblem: the branch of OAK leaves denotes steadfastness and devotion to service; laurel denotes honor and victory. So 'none of these' is correct.

question: Which part of the DeMolay emblem is emblematic of chivalry?
adminNote: 'The HELMET is emblematic of chivalry.'

question: Which virtue speaks of loyalty to one’s friends and ideals?
adminNote: Ethic: 'A DeMolay is loyal to ideals and friends.' (fidelity)

question: The eighth ethic of a DeMolay is a restatement of which cardinal virtue?
adminNote: The 8th of the 14 ethics is 'A DeMolay is courteous.' Exam file typos: 'eight' (eighth), 'Scared' (Sacred).

question: By granting a subordinate Chapter a __________, the Supreme Council grants recognition to that Chapter, the authority to confer the Degrees of the Order and the permission to use the name “DeMolay.”
adminNote: A Charter is the permanent grant. Letters Temporary/Dispensation are temporary (handbook: Letters Temporary Dec 1983, Charter Oct 7, 1984).

question: He is responsible for giving recognition to deserving Active and Senior members of the Chapter for outstanding services to the Chapter and the Order.
He is the second-in-command of the Chapter and in most cases, heads the alternate official line of the Chapter.
adminNote: Handbook: the SC is the second in command.

question: The Master Councilor is to a Chapter as the __________ is to a Preceptory.
adminNote: Legion of Honor Preceptories are led by a Dean.

question: The last pearl in the DeMolay emblem honors __________.
“No DeMolay shall fail as a __________, as __________, and as a __________.”
adminNote: 'No DeMolay shall fail as a citizen, as a leader and as a man.'

question: This virtue emphasizes the point that there is nothing effeminate in a young man who shows his love and appreciation for his parents.
“A DeMolay is clean in __________ and __________.”
adminNote: 'A DeMolay is clean in mind and body.'
